notablePrerequisites:
Vizier of Many Faces on the battlefield as a copy of Forensic Researcher.
Forensic Researcher and Vizier of Many Faces do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Vizier of Many Faces.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Vizier of Many Faces.
Activate Vizier of Many Faces by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Vizier of Many Faces ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.
